class.name: VECSWorld
class.brief_description: The main entry point of VortarisECS: a Node wrapping one ECS world. Registered as the [code]VECS[/code] engine singleton.
class.description:
[b]VECSWorld[/b] is a [Node] that owns a single entity-component-system world and exposes it to GDScript. It is registered as the [code]VECS[/code] engine singleton, so scripts can call [code]VECS.get_world()[/code] to reach it.
Use it to create and destroy entities, register script-defined components, run queries, iterate over component sets, flush deferred structural changes, and serialize/deserialize the world. Script-defined (schema-only) components registered here behave identically to C++ components compiled into the extension.
Entities are referenced through lightweight [VECSEntity] handles. Component values are read and written through [VECSComponent] accessors, or with the convenience [method get_field] / [method set_field] / [method spawn] / [method each] sugar.

method.name: add_observer
method.description: Registers [param observer] with this world. The observer starts receiving component events (ADDED / REMOVED / CHANGED / MATCHED / UNMATCHED / custom) according to its [member VECSObserver.events] mask and component filter.

method.name: add_system
method.description: Registers [param system] for execution. The system joins its [member VECSSystem.group]; call [method process] with that group to tick it. On registration the system's [code]_setup[/code] hook runs so it can build cached views against this world.

method.name: commands
method.description: Returns the world's shared [VECSCommandBuffer]. Structural changes (add/remove component, destroy entity) issued inside an iteration must be deferred through this buffer and flushed once with [method VECSCommandBuffer.flush]. All handles returned by this method share the same underlying world-level buffer.

method.name: compact
method.description: Frees archetypes that no longer hold any entity and reclaims their memory. Safe to call periodically (e.g. after scene transitions) if many component sets have emptied out.

method.name: create_entity
method.description: Creates a new entity with no components and returns a handle to it. Components can then be added with [method VECSEntity.add_component] or via the convenience [method spawn].

method.name: create_entity_preassigned
method.description: Creates an entity with an explicit id (slot + generation packed into the 64-bit value). Used by snapshot loading and network replication so ids stay stable across worlds. Returns a null handle if the id is invalid or the slot is already occupied.

method.name: deserialize_snapshot
method.description: Loads a binary snapshot produced by [method serialize_snapshot] into this world. Loading replaces the existing world contents. Returns [code]true[/code] on success, [code]false[/code] on a version mismatch or malformed data.

method.name: deserialize_snapshot_json
method.description: Loads a JSON save produced by [method serialize_snapshot_json]. Accepts either an already-parsed [Dictionary] or a JSON [String]. Loading replaces the existing world contents; unknown components are skipped with a warning, entity ids are preserved. Returns [code]true[/code] only if every entity spawned.

method.name: destroy_entity
method.description: Destroys [param entity] immediately (not deferred). Dispatching a REMOVED event for each of its components. No-op if the entity is already dead. To destroy inside an iteration, use [method VECSCommandBuffer.remove_entity] instead.

method.name: each
method.description: Calls [param callable] once per entity that has every component named in [param components] (e.g. [code]["Position", "Velocity"][/code]). Unlike [method query].execute, no [Array] is materialized — suitable for iterating large populations. The callable receives the entity as a [VECSEntity]. Do not perform structural changes inside the callable.

method.name: emit_event
method.description: Broadcasts a custom event to observers that subscribe to [code]name[/code]. [param payload] is passed through unchanged; [param entity] may be a null handle for events that do not concern a specific entity.

method.name: entities_to_data
method.description: Exports every entity as an [Array] of dictionaries of the form [code][{"id": int, "components": {"Name": {field: value}}}, ...][/code], in deterministic order (archetypes sorted by signature). Inverse of [method spawn_from_data]. Prefer the binary [method serialize_snapshot] for large worlds.

method.name: entity_count
method.description: Returns the number of live entities in the world.

method.name: get_component_type
method.description: Returns metadata for the component type registered as [param name], or a null handle if it is not registered. The returned [VECSComponentType] exposes field names, sizes and sync priorities.

method.name: get_field
method.description: Convenience sugar for [method VECSEntity.getf]: reads a single field of a component on [param entity]. Returns [code]null[/code] if the component or field does not exist.

method.name: get_world
method.description: Returns this node. Provided so systems and scripts can reach the world through a consistent accessor.

method.name: is_alive
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if [param entity] refers to a live entity in this world. Stale handles (from a destroyed or recycled entity) return [code]false[/code].

method.name: process
method.description: Ticks every registered system in [param group] with [param delta] seconds. Call this once per frame (or at a fixed timestep) for each group of systems you run.

method.name: query
method.description: Returns a new fluent query builder. Chain [method VECSQueryBuilder.with_all], [method VECSQueryBuilder.with_any], [method VECSQueryBuilder.with_none], [method VECSQueryBuilder.changed] and [method VECSQueryBuilder.enabled], then terminate with [method VECSQueryBuilder.execute] / [method VECSQueryBuilder.execute_one] / [method VECSQueryBuilder.count].

method.name: register_component
method.description: Registers a script-defined (schema-only) component. [param fields] is an [Array] of dictionaries, each with a [code]name[/code] and a [code]type[/code] (one of [code]Bool[/code], [code]I8[/code]..[code]I64[/code], [code]U8[/code]..[code]U64[/code], [code]F32[/code]/[code]F64[/code], [code]Vector2[/code]..[code]Vector4[/code]([code]i[/code]), [code]Color[/code], [code]Quaternion[/code], [code]Basis[/code], [code]Transform2D[/code]/[code]3D[/code], [code]AABB[/code], [code]Rect2[/code], [code]Plane[/code], [code]StringFixed[/code], [code]Blob[/code]) and optional keys [code]count[/code], [code]sync_priority[/code] and [code]networked[/code]. Returns [code]false[/code] if a field is malformed or the name is already registered.

method.name: register_components
method.description: Batch-registers several schema components at once: [code]{"Name": [{name, type, ...}, ...], ...}[/code]. Convenient for loading data tables (e.g. cards, items).

method.name: remove_observer
method.description: Unregisters [param observer] so it stops receiving events.

method.name: remove_system
method.description: Unregisters [param system] so it is no longer ticked.

method.name: serialize_snapshot
method.description: Serializes the whole world to a deterministic binary snapshot (little-endian, fixed-width, byte-identical across runs). Load with [method deserialize_snapshot].

method.name: serialize_snapshot_json
method.description: Serializes the whole world as a JSON-able [Dictionary]: [code]{"version": int, "entities": [...]}[/code]. Pass it to [method JSON.stringify] to write a save file.

method.name: set_entity_range
method.description: Pre-reserves entity id slots up to [param base] so later ids stay within a range. Useful when combining network-assigned ids with locally-created ones. Out-of-range values are rejected.

method.name: set_field
method.description: Convenience sugar for [method VECSEntity.setf]: writes a single field of a component on [param entity] and marks it changed. No-op if the component or field does not exist.

method.name: spawn
method.description: Convenience sugar: creates an entity and adds every component in [param components] in one call, e.g. [code]spawn({"Position": {"x": 1.0}, "Velocity": {"x": 0.5}})[/code]. Returns a handle to the new entity, or a null handle if spawning failed.

method.name: spawn_from_data
method.description: Batch-creates entities from data: [code][{"id"?: int, "components": {"Name": {field: value}}}, ...][/code]. Entities that fail to spawn (e.g. an id conflict) are skipped. Returns the array of created [VECSEntity] handles.

method.name: system_count
method.description: Returns the number of registered systems.
